iterations.summary: Removed the DCache load-completion bypass from the next memory operation's AGU base while retaining it for ordinary consumers, then increased the direct-mapped BTB from 128 to 512 entries to recover the dependent-memory stall cost without changing prediction policy, history or update semantics.

board_safety.request_slice_policy: Requests already accepted by the frontend are never flushed; stale responses return normally and are discarded by the frontend epoch mechanism. Flushing an accepted request can strand pending metadata and reproduce the historical no-response or repeated-trap board failure.
board_safety.clock_contract: MMCM, RTL SoC/UART constant, board metadata, timer, CoreMark timebase, software, ELF and BRAM images are one generated 170 MHz set.
board_safety.branch_prediction: v3.2 changes only direct-mapped BTB capacity from 128 to 512. GShare policy, history, counters and update semantics are unchanged.
board_safety.true_170mhz_physical_board_status: pending; simulation and bitstream generation passed

decision.reason: At the same true 170 MHz contract, v3.2 costs only 714 cycles (0.0042 s per CoreMark 10000) while improving final WNS by 0.095 ns, reducing TNS violation by 322.520 ns, reducing failing endpoints by 161 and raising estimated timing-limited Fmax by 2.08 MHz. No v3.3 iteration is planned.
